The '''Juggernaut Mag fist''' was a model of [[Repulsor fist/Legends|repulsor fist]], a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] weapon [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]], produced by [[Illicit Electronics]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="LoNH" />
